title: fhirviews: FHIR desde R y vistas tabulares con SQL on FHIR
description: R client for FHIR R4 servers and SQL on FHIR view engine. Includes explicit SQL/table mappings to Patient, Observation, Encounter, Condition and Immunization, JSON/NDJSON output, decimal precision and R4 structural checks. Clinical and national profiles require validation against their canonical definitions. Development versions must be identified as such when deposited.
